title: fix(twitch): block chat when setup group access is disabled
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Choosing **Disabled** in Twitch setup could still admit mentioned chat when the account had no user ID allowlist.

## User Impact

Disabled now blocks chat for the selected account, including base/default and named-account configurations. Open and Disabled discard previous user IDs; switching back to Allowlist does not restore them and uses moderator/VIP roles unless a nonempty ID list is configured.

Legacy configurations with empty or absent roles and no `allowFrom` remain open. There is no automatic migration because those values do not record the intended policy. Reselect **Disabled** or set `allowFrom: []` to block chat.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use the existing channel configuration patch helper to explicitly empty or remove the allowlist, and report the policy using the runtime's precedence. Preserve account fields and enable behavior without changing the runtime, DM policy, credential writer, schema, or SDK.

Config-aware status checks also accept the intentional empty allowlist instead of recommending its removal. Other configuration and runtime diagnostics remain intact.

## Evidence

- Identical regression fixture failed before the repair and passed afterward through the real setup policy callback, account reader, and core ingress policy.
- A frozen setup-to-status fixture failed on the extra empty-allowlist diagnostic, then passed after its removal while retaining the never-connected runtime issue.
- 116 focused cases passed across the status (12) and sibling (104) runs. All 26 selected checks passed; fresh review of the complete five-file diff found no P0-P2 issues.
- `setup-surface.test.ts` alone: 46 cases, one worker, 39.846s managed command wall; reported file elapsed 76.93ms. `status.test.ts` alone: 12 cases, `maxWorkers=1`, 22.160s managed command wall; reported file elapsed 38.918945ms. Managed times include wrapper/startup/setup, not CI or performance measurements.
- Required CI and both required gate entries passed for `5117a729` ([run 36095205260](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36095205260)). The completed [ClawSweeper review record](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/actions/runs/36095365280/artifacts/10847721167) reports no remaining findings and clears security; its public comment publication was rate-limited.
- Hosted [job 107946795247](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36095205260/job/107946795247) for `5117a729`: printed passing-case durations sum to 0.153s for 46 setup cases and 0.088s for 12 status cases. These are not file wall times, complete import/setup costs, or a performance-change measurement.
- Tests exercise the setup callback, not the full interactive wizard. The status correction is proven with a config callback; current SDK/CLI callers supply snapshots only, so no live CLI impact is claimed. No live Twitch account or network test was run.
